summary.title: Watch: Log Carbs fallback when bolus is zero
changes: If the recommended bolus is zero, the watch shows a "No Bolus, Log Carbs" button so you can log carbs without a bolus.
Turning the insulin dial above zero restores the "Enact Bolus" button and opens the bolus confirmation flow.
Tapping the "No Bolus, Log Carbs" button logs the carbs from the watch and shows an acknowledgment screen.
The watch shows a "Calculating Bolus..." progress state while waiting for the phone and clears it on reply, error, or a.
The insulin amount is snapped to the configured increment so tiny dial residues do not count as a non-zero bolus.
